titulo.en: A visit to the hospital and the Sunday Market

dialogo.s: เพื่อน|pʉ̂ʉan ของ|kɔ̌ɔng เขา|kǎo ไม่สบาย|mâi-sà-baai มา|maa หลาย|lǎai วัน|wan แล้ว|lɛ́ɛo
dialogo.fsi: phʉ̂an khɔ̌ɔŋ kháw mâjsabaaj maa lǎaj wan lɛ́ɛw
dialogo.en: His friend has been ill for several days.
dialogo.pt: O amigo está doente faz vários dias.

dialogo.s: เขา|kǎo ให้|hâi คนใช้|kon-chái ไป|bpai เรียก|rîiak แท็กซี่|tɛ́k-sîi ให้|hâi เขา|kǎo
dialogo.fsi: kháw hâj khonchái paj rîak thɛ́ksîi hâj kháw

dialogo.pt: Mandou a empregada chamar um táxi para ele.

dialogo.s: เขา|kǎo ไม่|mâi อยาก|yàak ไป|bpai เรียก|rîiak เอง|eeng
dialogo.fsi: kháw mâj jàak paj rîak ʔeeŋ
dialogo.en: He didn't want to go for one himself,
dialogo.pt: Não quis ir chamar ele mesmo,

dialogo.fsi: phrɔ́ weelaa thɛ́ksîi hěn faràŋ kháw mákcà bɔ̀ɔk raakhaa phɛɛŋ
dialogo.en: because when taxis see a Westerner they ask for higher fares.
dialogo.pt: porque, quando o taxista vê um estrangeiro, costuma pedir mais caro.

dialogo.s: คนใช้|kon-chái เรียก|rîiak แท็กซี่|tɛ́k-sîi มา|maa ให้|hâi เขา|kǎo คัน|kan หนึ่ง|nʉ̀ng

dialogo.en: The servant called a taxi for him.
dialogo.pt: A empregada chamou um táxi para ele.

dialogo.fsi: pen rót màj
dialogo.en: It was a new car.
dialogo.pt: Era um carro novo.

dialogo.pt: O motorista calculou a corrida em quinze baht.

dialogo.fsi: khun cɔɔn bɔ̀ɔk wâa phɛɛŋ paj
dialogo.en: John said it was too expensive.
dialogo.pt: O John disse que estava caro demais.

dialogo.fsi: kháw hâj khonchái tɔ̀ɔ sìp bàat

dialogo.pt: Mandou a empregada pechinchar por dez.

dialogo.pt: O taxista disse que sem doze baht não ia,

dialogo.fsi: kháw paj thʉ̌ŋ thîinân cháa kəənpaj
dialogo.en: He got there too late,
dialogo.pt: Chegou lá tarde demais

dialogo.en: so he didn't get to visit his friend in time.
dialogo.pt: e acabou não dando tempo de visitar o amigo.

dialogo.en: John spent hours walking around the Sunday Market.
dialogo.pt: O John passou horas passeando pela feira.

dialogo.pt: utensílios, plantas e bichos de estimação.

dialogo.pt: Umas coisas eram baratas, outras caras.

dialogo.pt: Comprou brinquedos para os filhos e utensílios para a esposa.

dialogo.fsi: kháw cà sòŋ khɔ̌ɔŋ làwníi paj ʔameerikaa tɔɔn khrítsamâat
dialogo.en: He'll send these things to America at Christmas.
dialogo.pt: Vai mandar essas coisas para os Estados Unidos no Natal.

dialogo.fsi: sǎmràp nɔ́ɔŋsǎaw kháw jaŋ mâj sâap wâa cà hâj ʔaraj dii
dialogo.en: For his younger sister, he still didn't know what to give.
dialogo.pt: Para a irmã mais nova, ainda não sabia o que dar.

dialogo.pt: Enquanto procurava um táxi, encontrou um amigo

dialogo.en: Saman studied in America.
dialogo.pt: O Saman estudou nos Estados Unidos.

dialogo.en: After he graduated, he returned to Thailand

dialogo.fsi: lɛ́ thamŋaan pen khâarâatchakaan krasuaŋmahàatthaj
dialogo.en: and worked as an official of the Ministry of the Interior.

dialogo.fsi: kháw dâj thun paj duuŋaan thîi ʔameerikaa
dialogo.en: He got a grant to go observe work in America.
dialogo.pt: Ganhou uma bolsa para fazer uma visita técnica nos Estados Unidos.

dialogo.fsi: tɔɔnnán kháw phóp khonthaj lǎaj khon

dialogo.pt: Naquela época o John conheceu muitos tailandeses,

dialogo.en: because the officials would introduce the students to Thais
dialogo.pt: porque os funcionários apresentavam os alunos a tailandeses

dialogo.fsi: phʉ̂a hâj hàt phûut phaasǎathaj kàp khonthaj
dialogo.en: so they could practice speaking Thai with Thais.
dialogo.pt: para que eles treinassem o tailandês com nativos.

vocab.th: สัตว์เลี้ยง

t.pt: เมื่อ + nome ou + frase
t.en: เมื่อ + phrase or clause

e.pt: เมื่อ + expressão de tempo fala do passado: เมื่อคืนนี้ (ontem à noite), เมื่อเด็กๆ (na infância). เมื่อ + frase pode ser passado (ผมมาเมื่อเขาไปแล้ว = cheguei quando ele já tinha ido) ou futuro e condição (เมื่อผมมีรถ ผมจะไปได้ = quando eu tiver carro, vou poder ir).
e.en: เมื่อ + time phrase: past; เมื่อ + clause: past, future or conditional.

notas.ex: เมื่อ|mʉ̂ʉa ผม|pǒm มี|mii รถ|rót ผม|pǒm จะ|jà ไป|bpai

t.pt: เสร็จ × จบ: terminar
t.en: เสร็จ vs จบ

e.pt: เสร็จ encerra uma atividade em geral (ทำงานเสร็จ = acabou de trabalhar); จบ completa algo com duração prevista ou com fim marcado (เรียนจบ = formou-se; ดูหนังไม่จบ = não viu o filme até o fim). Analogia: เสร็จ é desligar o computador; จบ é chegar à última página do livro.
e.en: เสร็จ: finish an activity; จบ: complete something with a set end.

notas.ex: เขา|kǎo เรียน|riian จบ|jòp แล้ว|lɛ́ɛo

t.pt: Narrar com เลย e ก็
t.en: Narrating with เลย and ก็

e.pt: เลย liga causa e consequência ('aí, por isso'): ไปถึงช้า เลยไปเยี่ยมไม่ทัน. ก็ marca o passo seguinte ou opõe frases paralelas: บางอย่างก็ถูก บางอย่างก็แพง.
e.en: เลย: so, consequently; ก็: next step or parallel contrast.

notas.ex: เขา|kǎo ป่วย|bpùuai เลย|ləəi ไม่|mâi มา|maa
